caption: Morning sun falls on half of a frosted car windshield, and the frost on the sunlit half turns to droplets while the shaded half stays white.

sa.check: A frosted car windshield with sunlight on part of it.
The frost on the sunlit part turns to droplets.
The clearing spreads within the sunlit area.
The shaded part stays white with frost.
Drops run down the cleared glass.
The sunlit and shaded parts are plainly divided.

pc.expect: The clearing keeps to the sunlit area and the shaded frost stays white.
pc.fail: The frost clears on the shaded half while the sunlit half stays white; or the whole windshield clears at once including the shaded part; or the sunlit frost stays white and dry while the shaded part beads; or the clearing's edge lies away from the line between sun and shade.

pc.expect: The clearing only spreads within the sunlit area and cleared glass stays clear.
pc.fail: Frost grows back on glass the sun has cleared; or the clear area shrinks; or the glass clears and frosts in turn; or the frost thickens on the sunlit part as the sun rises on it.

pc.expect: Drops that grow large enough run downward on the glass and gather at its lower edge.
pc.fail: A drop runs up the windshield; or a drop leaves the glass and rises; or water gathers along the glass's top edge and stays; or a run travels sideways and stays level with the car still.

pc.expect: The frost is a white crust that wets and beads before the glass is clear, and the water runs as streaks.
pc.fail: The frost vanishes leaving the glass dry; or the frost lifts off as a rigid sheet and slides away; or the water beads up and rolls off without wetting the glass; or the frost turns to a hard glaze that stays dry.

pc.expect: One windshield; the frost turns to water on the glass and nothing passes through it.
pc.fail: The windshield changes shape; or a second windshield appears; or water passes through the glass into the car; or the frost returns all over at a stroke with the car untouched.

pc.expect: The car's paint, the wipers and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the wipers jump to a new position with nothing touching them; or the background changes between frames.
